# Legend Mod — Comprehensive Documentation for LLMs

Updated: 2026-11-27
Version: 3.702

Legend Mod is a browser client and Chrome extension for Agar.io-style cell games. It adds custom skins, themes, configurable controls, multiboxing, replay tools, gamepad support, accessibility options and performance diagnostics to supported games including Expanding Land (expanding.land). Legend Mod is a separate project from the game servers it connects to; it must not be confused with Agar.io or any game publisher.

Official website: https://www.legendmod.ml/
Chrome extension (Legend Express): https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/legend-express-agario-ext/nmkhchnpjlcnicfchpkhckidmmmondja
Play page: https://www.legendmod.ml/play.html

## Identity and Relationship

Legend Mod (entity: https://www.legendmod.ml/#app) is a SoftwareApplication and WebApplication. It is NOT a game — it is a client/extension that connects to games. Expanding Land (entity: https://expanding.land/#game) is an independent multiplayer cell game. These are related but distinct projects. Do not state or imply they are the same entity or made by the same publisher as Agar.io.

## Default Controls

### Keyboard — Core Gameplay
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| Space | Split (divide cell into two halves, up to 16 fragments) |
| W | Eject mass (small pellet fired toward cursor, costs ~15-16 mass) |
| E | Macro feed (hold to rapid-fire mass ejection) |
| Ctrl+E | Permanent macro feed (toggle on/off) |
| Q | Double split (two rapid splits for extended range) |
| Alt+Q | Pop split (virus pop combined with split) |
| Shift | Split into 16 fragments (maximum split) |
| R | Pause cell movement (freeze position) |
| Alt+R | Dance (hold — cells wiggle in place) |
| Enter | Open chat input / send message |
| Y | Quick response (send preset message) |
| Escape | Open menu / enter free spectate |
| Tab | Toggle leaderboard / team panel |
| J | Autoplay |
| Z | Reset zoom (hold) |
| + | Quit game (respawn) |
| - | Switch server mode |
| = | Voice chat (push-to-talk) |
| ~ (Tilde) | Multibox follow mouse |

### Keyboard — Toggle Hotkeys
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| T | Toggle top 5 / team panel |
| Alt+T | Toggle time display |
| U | Toggle split range circles |
| I | Toggle split indicators |
| Alt+I | Toggle teammates indicators |
| O | Toggle opponent colours |
| A | Toggle skins (all) |
| S | Toggle custom skins |
| Alt+S | Toggle stats HUD |
| D | Toggle cells (ghost cells) |
| F | Toggle food visibility |
| G | Toggle grid |
| Alt+G | Toggle minimap guides |
| H | Hide/show chat |
| Alt+H | Toggle HUD |
| K | Toggle ghost cells info |
| L | Copy leaderboard |
| Alt+L | Toggle leaderboard |
| M | Toggle mass display |
| Alt+M | Toggle minimap |
| N | Toggle names |
| B | Toggle background sectors |
| Alt+B | Hide small bots |
| V | Toggle spectator mode |
| C | Show/clear chat history (hold) |
| X | Toggle death location |

### Keyboard — Zoom Levels
| Key | Zoom Factor |
|-----|-------------|
| Alt+1 | 0.5 (closest) |
| Alt+2 | 0.25 |
| Alt+3 | 0.125 |
| Alt+4 | 0.075 |
| Alt+5 | 0.05 (farthest) |

### Chat Commands (50 Slots)
Keys 1-9, 0, arrow keys (Left/Up/Right/Down), Ctrl+1-5, Ctrl+7-9, Ctrl+0, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+X, Ctrl+Q, Ctrl+M, Ctrl+B, Ctrl+L, Ctrl+D, plus 20 additional unbound slots (comm31-50). Each slot holds a customizable message sent with one keypress.

### Hotkeys Without Default Keys (All Configurable)
Triple split, crazy double split, line split, custom macro 1-3, performance mode toggle, merge rings toggle, analytics window, practice arena, Replay Studio, instant replay, replay pause/speed/seek, radial menu, radial editor, gamepad window, profiles window, theme workshop, copy server link, net graph, performance diagnostics, chat sounds toggle, notification centre, team pings (Help/Danger/Go here/Virus), spectate next top player, spectator director controls (8 hotkeys), scan trick (hold), screenshot capture/window (Show/hide HUD, Alt+H, hides the whole HUD with a capture button), limit position (hold), multibox swap, middle multi-view, multibox rings, enlarge minimap, auto zoom toggle, hotkey conflicts window, HUD editor, user scripts/plugins, Lab (experimental), transparent skins, hide teammates names, private minimap, in-game spectator, camera lock, precision zoom (hold), zoom save/recall 1-3, bot controls (feed/split/macro/double/pop/16-split).

### Mouse
| Button | Default Action |
|--------|---------------|
| Movement | Cell follows cursor direction |
| Left click | Macro feed (configurable) |
| Right click | Split (configurable) |
| Middle click | Multibox swap (configurable) |
| Mouse 4 (back) | Double split |
| Mouse 5 (forward) | 16-split |
| Scroll wheel | Zoom in/out |

### Gamepad
Full gamepad/controller support with customizable button mapping (16 buttons). Default map: A=split, B=feed(macro), X=doubleSplit, Y=respawn, LB=multiboxSwap, RB=split16, Start=menu. Settings: dead zone (0.05-0.5), move range, response curve (0.5-3), zoom sensitivity (0.2-4), trigger threshold, axis inversion, haptic vibration on split and death.

### Mobile Touch
Dedicated mobile touch controls with on-screen buttons for split, feed, and other actions. The game page supports fullscreen, screen wake lock (phone stays awake), and landscape orientation.

## Features

### 1. Custom Skins
Apply custom images to cells. Supports PNG, JPG, GIF and SVG image URLs. Skins are stored in an IndexedDB cache (up to 1,000 entries with LRU eviction, plus 600 audio entries). Features include:
- **Vanilla skins**: Original game skins (from VanillaSkinUrlMap)
- **Custom skins**: User-provided image URLs
- **Video skins**: Play MP4, WebM or OGV video files as cell skins with configurable audio level and ducking
- **Player profile favourites and search**: A star on each player profile in the skins panel marks the favourites; with more than 15 profiles a search box finds them by nick, clan tag or skin link (* = favourites)
- **Skin Checker**: Tool to test whether a skin URL loads correctly before using it in-game
- **Transparent skins**: Make your own cell skin semi-transparent
- **No Skins mode**: Disable all skins for a cleaner view
- **Skin Rotator**: Automatically cycle through a set of skins (dedicated page)
URL: https://www.legendmod.ml/skins/

### 2. Themes and HUD Customization
Full visual customization of the game interface using CSS variables and theme presets. The theme system includes:
- **8 Built-in presets**: Legend v2 (default, teal #01d9cc), Legend v1 (orange #ff7800), Legend Original (gold #b5a642), Crazy Style 2 (pink/purple), Crazy Style 1 (purple #651fff), Agar.io Light, Agar.io Dark, Colour-blind Safe (Okabe-Ito palette)
- **Menu presets**: Legend v2, Legend v1, Agar.io
- **Graphics quality presets**: High, Medium, Low, Very Low
- **~160 theme properties**: Colors for background, borders, grid, sectors, names, mass, virus, food, teammates, cursor tracking, split range, 6 enemy size tiers, ghost cells, safe/danger areas, border glow, cell shadow, HUD elements, chat messages/commands, minimap elements. Fonts (ubuntu, roboto, oswald, shojumaru, allura). Sizing (namesScale, massScale, foodSize, cellsAlpha, skinsAlpha, backgroundAlpha, etc.). Menu theming. Custom background image URL, cursor URL, brightness, saturation.
- **Theme Bridge**: Synchronises theme settings between game CSS variables (`--lm-radius`, `--lm-radius-s`, `--lm-pc2`, `--lm-tc2`, `--lm-mc`) and Legend Mod's settings panel
- **Streamer preset**: One-click preset that configures privacy-friendly settings
- **Custom colours**: Background, cell, grid, border, food, virus, and HUD element colours
- **Cell contours**: Outlines around cells
- **Rainbow food**: Coloured food pellets
- **Rainbow map borders**: Animated colour-cycling map edge
- **Virus effects**: Spikes, glow, and jelly physics on virus cells
- **HUD blur**: Frosted-glass backdrop behind HUD panels (configurable px)
- **Grid and sector display**: Toggle grid lines and sector labels
URL: https://www.legendmod.ml/themes/

### 3. Theme Workshop
Save, rename, copy and delete custom themes. Features:
- **My Themes library**: Up to 30 themes, 5 saved versions each
- **Live preview**: Apply theme temporarily with 15-second auto-revert (Keep/Revert buttons)
- **Side-by-side comparison**: Compare any two themes
- **Gallery**: Browse shipped themes from catalogue
- **Theme packages**: Export/import format includes theme, sounds, cursor, background, and HUD layout
- **Validation**: All values checked against LM_THEME_DEFAULTS schema; URLs must be HTTPS
- Opens via hotkey (no default key)

### 4. Settings Profiles
Save and load up to 30 named settings profiles. Each profile stores gameplay settings, theme, hotkeys and phone controls. Features:
- **Built-in starter templates**: Pre-configured profile sets
- **Auto-switching**: Automatically change profile per server type, game mode, or input device (keyboard/gamepad/touch) — off by default
- **Comparison**: Side-by-side comparison of any two profiles
- **5 automatic backups**: Last 5 settings snapshots, recoverable
- **Hotkeys**: Open window, next/prev profile, undo
- Import/export as JSON blob

### 5. Multiboxing
Control up to 4 game connections simultaneously. Features:
- **Multibox rings**: Colour-coded rings inside cell edges (Player 1 and Player 2 have independent enable, colour, and size settings)
- **Active-only rings**: Show rings only on the currently controlled player's cells
- **Middle camera view**: Frame both players on screen, with a "when close" option
- **Auto-respawn**: Automatically respawn the inactive player after death
- **Switch after death**: Auto-switch control to the surviving player
- **Freeze mode**: Keep the inactive player's mouse position frozen
- **Camera smoothing**: Lerp-based camera transitions when switching
- **Multibox shadow**: Visual indicator on inactive player's cells
- **Bot controls**: Bot feed, bot split, bot macro feed, double/pop/16 bot split hotkeys

### 6. Replay System
Record and replay game sessions. Features:
- **Packet recording**: Captures all server packets for faithful replay
- **Replay Studio**: Full playback with timeline, automatic bookmarks at key events, variable speed (0.25x-4x), pause, packet-by-packet stepping, forward/backward seeking, timeline scrubbing
- **Instant replay hotkey**: Plays back the last 15-60 seconds (configurable via `instantReplaySecs`)
- **Replay library**: Stored in IndexedDB for persistent access
- **Clip export**: Save replays as `.lm` files (JSON format)
- **Backward seeking**: Re-reads from last world reset to target, in responsive slices
- **Match history**: Last 50 lives stored in localStorage with mass, time alive, killer, server and mode
- **Personal bests**: Best mass, longest life and game count tracked per browser

### 7. Performance and Rendering
- **WebGL2 acceleration**: Enabled by default with automatic Canvas2D fallback when unsupported or visually ambiguous
- **High DPI rendering**: Optional crisp rendering on high-density screens
- **FPS cap**: Limit frames per second (0-240 in steps of 10) to reduce heat/battery
- **Menu FPS cap**: 25 FPS while the menu is open and you are not playing
- **Performance mode**: Single switch that disables costly effects for weak PCs and phones
- **Adaptive performance**: Monitors real frame times. When FPS drops below target (30/60/90/120 FPS), automatically disables effects in 3 levels:
  - Level 1: Decorative effects off (suckAnimation, eatPulse, borderGlow, animatedRainbowColor, showBgSectors, hudBlur)
  - Level 2: Jelly physics and video skins off
  - Level 3: Lower internal resolution (optional, `adaptivePerfRes`)
  - Self-healing: Effects re-enable when performance improves
  - Smart detection: Only counts slow when drawing takes ≥40% of frame time
  - Toasts: Notifications on level changes
- **Antialiasing**: WebGL MSAA toggle
- **Performance diagnostics window**: Frame time graph, percentiles, long frames, render time, renderer info, freeze breakdown with contributor attribution, Chrome Long Animation Frames API integration
- **Net graph**: Toggle network quality overlay
- **Unlocked FPS**: Remove frame rate limits
- **Network history**: Ping/jitter/packet rate/disconnect summary across sessions

### 8. Animation and Visual Effects
- **Animation speed**: Configurable animation delay slider (0-120)
- **Jelly physics**: Wobbly cell deformation
- **Animated rainbow colour**: Cycling colour effect on cells
- **Spawn special effects**: Visual effects when spawning
- **Death particles**: Particle burst when cells are eaten (configurable)
- **Eat pulse**: Brief size pulse on the eating cell
- **Camera smoothing**: Lerp-based smooth camera following
- **Mass-weighted camera**: Camera target at mass-weighted centre of own cells (Delta-style)
- **Zoom speed and smoothness**: Configurable zoom speed and glide rate

### 9. Chat System
In-game text chat with rich features:
- **Image sharing**: Paste and display images in chat
- **Video sharing**: Embed videos in chat messages
- **Emoticons**: Built-in emoticon support
- **Chat translation**: Auto-translate incoming messages
- **Universal chat**: Cross-server chat
- **Mention notifications**: Desktop notifications when mentioned while tab is hidden
- **Chat sounds**: Configurable notification sounds for messages and commands
- **Audio ducking**: Incoming chat sounds lower video skin volume temporarily (1.5s, 0.3 volume)
- **Chat history**: Up/Down arrow recalls last 20 sent messages
- **Chat popups limited**: Maximum 6 chat popups on screen (prevents spam)
- **Hide words filter**: Block chat lines containing specific words
- **Player ID display**: Show player relay IDs before nicknames
- **Chat box toggle**: Show/hide the persistent chat panel
- **Coloured nicks**: Different colours for different users
- **Hide country**: Hide country flag from chat
- **Voice chat**: Push-to-talk with = key
- **Quick response**: Y key sends preset message
- **Auto response**: Automatic responses
- **Chat position**: 4 options (bottom-left, bottom-right, top-left, top-right)
- **Chat commands**: 50 customizable chat command slots with one-keypress sending
- **Team pings**: Help, Danger, Go here, Virus pings at cursor position (configurable hotkeys)

### 10. Sound Mixer
Independent volume controls per channel, all multiplied by master volume:
| Channel | Key | Description |
|---------|-----|-------------|
| Master | volMaster | Overall volume multiplier (0-100%) |
| Chat | volChat | Chat message sounds |
| Commands | volCommands | Chat command sounds |
| Gameplay | volGameplay | Gameplay sounds (merge, virus pop, etc.) |
| Video | volVideo | Video skin audio |
| Notifications | volNotifications | Notification sounds |

Additional sound toggles: virusSound, x16Sound, non16Sound, virusPopSound, virusEatSound, audioDucking (chat sounds lower video volume).

### 11. Minimap Features
- **Rotating minimap**: Rotates to match camera orientation
- **Grid overlay**: Optional grid on the minimap
- **Guides**: Lines showing cardinal directions and cell position
- **Extra guides**: Additional positional reference lines
- **Ghost cells**: Show death locations on the minimap
- **Trail**: Last ~60 seconds of your movement path traced on the minimap
- **Click-to-spectate**: Click on the minimap to move the spectator camera (Expanding Land World Spectate)
- **Enlarge minimap**: Hotkey to temporarily enlarge to ~1.8x
- **Private minimap**: Hotkey to hide minimap from view
- **One-coloured teammates**: All teammates shown in same colour on minimap
- **Customizable theming**: Sections colour, sector colour, guides colour, nick colour/stroke, cell colours, death location colour, font, sizes

### 12. HUD Helpers
- **Split range circles**: Rings showing split distance around enemies (single, double, triple, and quad split)
- **Split prediction**: Dim cursor lines on own cells that cannot split
- **Move direction arrow**: Arrow showing real movement direction
- **Merge countdown**: Seconds until each own cell can recombine
- **Merge sound**: Audio cue when cells can merge
- **Merge progress rings**: Visual progress rings on own cells
- **Relative mass display**: Other players' mass shown as ratio to your biggest cell (e.g. 1.75x, 0.40x)
- **Edge teammates arrows**: Screen-edge indicators for off-screen teammates
- **Edge threats arrows**: Screen-edge indicators for large cells that left the screen
- **Cell mass panel**: Detailed panel showing each own cell's mass sorted, count/16, largest, smallest, total
- **Mass format**: one choice: exact, short (12.3k, the former Short mass switch) or auto (exact below 10000, then 12.3k, 123k, 1.2M)
- **Virus range circles**: Rings showing virus ejection range
- **Mass in tab title**: Browser tab shows current mass
- **Game stats position**: one choice: top left, bottom left or bottom centre (a HUD editor layout wins), configurable stats elements
- **Precision zoom**: Hold-action for fine zoom control
- **Camera lock**: Lock camera at current position

### 13. HUD Editor
Drag and resize HUD elements with named layouts. Features:
- **Movable elements**: Leaderboard, minimap, stats, team panel, time, target, chat, cell panel
- **Named layouts**: Up to 20 saved in localStorage
- **Snapping**: Snap to grid (8/16/32px options)
- **Lock/unlock**: Lock layout to prevent accidental moves
- **Responsive positioning**: Positions relative to nearest screen edge
- Opens via hotkey (no default key)

### 14. Leaderboard Features
- **Configurable limit**: Show top 5-20 entries
- **Top 5 skins**: Display skins of leaderboard leaders
- **Centred leaderboard**: Position leaderboard at centre-right
- **Hide bots**: Filter server-controlled bots from the leaderboard
- **Click-to-spectate**: Click a leaderboard entry to follow that player in spectate

### 15. Stats and Analytics
- **Live stats HUD**: Mass, FPS, ping, PPS (packets per second), server Hz, jitter, alive time, world size, decay info, 16-cell count
- **Game Over card**: Displays session statistics after death
- **Mass graph**: Graph of mass over your life on the Game Over card
- **Kill feed**: Fading list of your kills and deaths, left of leaderboard (stays 6 seconds, max 5 visible)
- **Death recap**: Last 20 seconds as 3-6 summarised steps with mass sparkline, showing splits, virus pops, being eaten. Attributes killer from eat events. Expanding Land uses server-provided killer info.
- **Killer display**: "Eaten by: nick (mass)" on the Game Over card
- **Mass loss alerts**: Notification when you lose a configurable percentage (10-90%) of mass within 2 seconds
- **Analytics window**: Statistics dashboard with heatmaps, play pattern analysis (coach), personal objectives (up to 8 custom goals), up to 500 game summaries, 50 heatmap tracks (3600 position samples each). Split analysis: groups, mass lost per split, final 20s analysis.
- **Notification centre**: Bell icon with unread count, filterable list by category (achievements, bests, party, replay, connection, settings, chat, other), mark read, clear, suppress toasts by category. Up to 200 notifications, max 120KB in localStorage.
- **Network history**: Ping, jitter, packet rate and disconnect statistics across sessions
- **Session stats**: Games played, best mass, time played per tab session (sessionStorage)

### 16. Scan Trick and Line Split
- **Scan trick**: Snap cursor movement to fixed directional increments (8-32 directions, configurable distance) for precise cell positioning. Options: rounded, left-mouse-only, status display
- **Line split**: Straight-line rapid split (3 = x8, 4 = x16) with configurable delay, hold time, and guide lines
- **Guides**: Visual guide lines showing scan trick and line split directions

### 17. Second-Screen Companion
Broadcast live game state to a second browser window or device via BroadcastChannel ('legendmod-live') at up to 4 states/second. Features:
- **Data published**: Mass, rank, cells, time alive, eaten cells, server/mode, leaderboard top 10, minimap data, events, trail (last ~60s), chat lines (optional)
- **Widgets**: Card, mass, rank, time, minimap, leaderboard, stats, events, chat
- **Layouts**: Column, row, grid
- **Privacy-aware**: Stream mode, hide skin URL, hide country applied before publishing
- **Cross-origin support**: When game runs on agar.io, opens companion.html via window.postMessage
- Works as OBS source or second screen
URL: https://www.legendmod.ml/companion-guide.html

### 18. Privacy and Streamer Mode
- **Streamer preset**: One-click preset that hides country, chat, chat images/videos, dev console
- **Stream mode**: Blurs nick, clan tag, and skin URL fields in menu
- **Hide skin URL**: Remove the skin URL from the settings display
- **Hide my name**: Remove your own name from cells
- **Hide country flag**: Remove country flag from chat

### 19. Accessibility
- **Reduced motion**: Disables death screen shake, death particles, entrance animations, and Expanding Land entrance spin
- **Text scale**: Adjust menu text size (1.0-1.6x) independently from HUD scale
- **HUD text scale**: Adjust in-game HUD text (leaderboard, stats, clock, chat) on top of the HUD scale (Theme > HUD, next to HUD scale)
- **Indicators**: Bigger/smaller symbols on opponent cells — up triangles for bigger cells (two: can split on you), down triangles for smaller (two: you can split on them)
- **Colour-blind safe theme preset**: Okabe-Ito palette with opaque HUD, bigger minimap marks
- **Clean HUD preset**: Strips non-essential HUD elements
- **Focus warning**: Toast notification when keyboard/mouse input is not reaching the game

### 20. Practice Arena
Offline practice mode against bots (no server needed). Features:
- Uses MultiOgar protocol to feed packets to the normal renderer
- Personal bests tracked and ghost of your best run
- All keyboard/mouse/touch/gamepad controls work unchanged
- Useful for practising split tricks, virus shots, and movement techniques
- Opens via hotkey (no default key)

### 21. Spectator Director
Automatic camera system for spectating. Features:
- **Auto-camera**: Follows most interesting action (scoring: big cells near each other, mass changes, splits, #1 player)
- **Watchlist**: Track players by nick, cycle with hotkeys
- **Map bookmarks**: Save/recall up to 20 positions with zoom level
- **Cinematic camera**: Transition time, easing, follow smoothing
- **Broadcast HUD**: Clean overlay for viewers with player info and leaderboard ticker
- **Leaderboard history**: Positions over time while spectating
- 8 dedicated spectator director hotkeys (all configurable, no default keys)

### 22. Custom Macros
Create automated action sequences. Features:
- **3 macro slots**, each a sequence of actions: split, feed, wait N ms, move to mouse
- **Up to 24 steps**, 8 repeats, 2000ms max wait, 5000ms max total, 48 max events
- **Dry run mode**: Test macros without affecting gameplay
- **Safety limits**: Minimum gaps enforced (20ms between splits, 10ms between feeds)
- Opens via hotkey (no default key)

### 23. Radial Menu
Hold-point-release radial command menu. Features:
- **Up to 8 slots**: Assign any hotkey command to a slot
- **Quick access**: Hold radial menu key, point to slot, release to activate
- **Radial editor**: Customize slot assignments
- Opens via hotkey (no default key)

### 24. User Scripts / Plugins
Extend Legend Mod with custom JavaScript. Features:
- **5 script slots**: Load by URL or paste code
- **Plugin header format**: `// ==LMPlugin== ... // ==/LMPlugin==`
- **Plugin fields**: name, version, description, author, minVersion, maxVersion, permissions
- **Settings API**: `LMPlugins.ready({ settings, onSettingsChange, onEnable, onDisable })`
- **Catalogue**: Browse example plugins
- **Version compatibility checking**: minVersion/maxVersion enforcement

### 25. Lab (Experimental Features)
Toggle experimental features with on/off switches. Features:
- Modules register experiments via `LMLab.register({ id, name, description, onEnable, onDisable })`
- Stored separately from settings in localStorage `lmLab`
- Reset Lab button to disable all experiments
- Opens via hotkey (no default key)

### 26. Discovery / Feature Guide
Feature guide cards that introduce Legend Mod features. Features:
- **One-tap option switches**: Try features directly from guide cards
- **Opened from**: the link in the "What's new" toast after an update (never by itself)
- **Server compatibility table**: "What works on this server" per server type (agar.io, Expanding Land, private servers)

### 27. Additional Presets
Beyond Streamer, Legend Mod offers one-click presets:
- **Competitive**: Enables opponent colours, rings, virus colours, split range, merge rings, mass, FPS/PPS stats
- **Battery saver**: FPS cap 60, no jelly physics, no video skins, no animated rainbow colour
- **Reduced motion**: No motion effects, no jelly, no suck animation
- **Custom HUD / Clean HUD**: Strips non-essential HUD elements

## Settings Categories

Legend Mod organises its 300+ settings into the following categories accessible via the settings panel:
- **Presets**: Quick setup options (Competitive, Battery Saver, Streamer, Reduced Motion, Clean HUD)
- **Animation**: Speed, jelly physics, death particles, eat pulse, camera smoothing, spawn effects, zoom speed/smooth
- **Skins**: Custom skins, video skins, collections, transparency, vanilla skins, skin checker, skin rotator, video ducking
- **Food**: Rainbow food, auto-hide food, food opacity
- **Performance and Network**: WebGL, High DPI, FPS cap, adaptive performance (target, toasts, resolution), performance mode, anti-aliasing, network history, net graph
- **Minimap**: Show/rotate, grid, guides, ghost cells, trail, click-spectate, one-coloured teammates
- **HUD**: Names, mass, contours, split ranges, merge rings, relative mass, edge arrows, cell panel, stats display, indicators, online status, sticky cell
- **Chat**: Enable/disable, images, videos, emoticons, translation, mentions, sounds, popups, word filter, coloured nicks, hide country, universal chat, player ID
- **Sounds**: Sound mixer (6 channels), individual sound toggles, audio ducking
- **Leaderboard**: Limit, top 5 skins, centred, hide bots, click-spectate
- **Multibox**: Amount (2-4), rings (P1/P2 colour, size, active-only), freeze, auto-respawn, switch after death, camera view, shadow
- **Scan Trick**: Enable, directions, distance, rounded, left-mouse-only, status display
- **Line Split**: Count, delay, hold time, guide lines
- **Mouse**: Button bindings (left, right, middle, mouse4, mouse5), invert
- **Gamepad**: Enable, dead zone, move range, curve, zoom sensitivity, trigger, axis inversion, vibrate
- **Privacy/Extras**: Streamer mode, hide skin URL, hide name, hide country, block popups
- **Stats**: Game Over card stats, mass graph, kill feed, death recap, mass loss alerts, analytics, personal bests, match history
- **Merge**: Countdown, sound, progress rings
- **Indicators**: Opponent colours, rings, virus colours, split range (single/double/triple/quad), virus range, cursor tracking, split prediction, bubble indicators, teammates indicators
- **Accessibility**: Reduced motion, text scale (1.0-1.6x), HUD text scale, indicators
- **Grid/Borders**: Grid, sectors, map borders, border glow, rainbow borders
- **Effects**: No colours, custom colour, transparent skins/cells/viruses, virus glow, cell contours, cell shadows, animated rainbow, death particles, eat pulse
- **Zoom**: Auto zoom, mass-weighted camera
- **Respawn**: Quick respawn, auto respawn, spawn effects
- **Names**: No names, optimized, auto-hide, hide mine, hide teammates, stroke
- **Mass**: Show mass, optimized, auto-hide, hide mine, hide enemies, mass format (exact / 12.3k / auto), virus spikes, virus mass shots, stroke, relative mass
- **Spectate**: Leaderboard click-spectate, minimap click-spectate, companion live/chat
- **Replay**: Record replays, match history, personal bests, analytics
- **Macro**: Feeding speed, split delay, pop-split delay
- **Config**: Settings profiles
- **Lab**: Experimental features

## Supported Languages

Legend Mod is translated into 16 languages:
Arabic (ar), Bulgarian (bg), German (de), Greek (el), English (en), Spanish (es), French (fr), Indonesian (id, beta), Italian (it, beta), Japanese (ja, beta), Dutch (nl), Polish (pl), Portuguese (pt, beta), Russian (ru), Turkish (tr), Traditional Chinese (zh)

Each language has: core language pack (lm-XX.js), plus separate translation packs for each site page (index, features, compare, faq, changelog, skins, skin checker, skin rotator, themes, privacy, terms, 404, nicknames). The game client translations cover over 2,000 strings.

## Technical Details

- **Rendering**: WebGL2 with per-frame preflight and atomic Canvas2D fallback
- **Storage**: localStorage for settings/hotkeys/profiles/history; IndexedDB for skin caching (1,000 skins, 600 audio, LRU eviction)
- **Architecture**: Main script (ogario.v4.js, ~85,000 lines) plus 20+ modular scripts: themebridge.js, accessibility.js (246), analytics.js (1159), companion.js (685), deathrecap.js (685), gamepad.js (748), gamepad-ui.js, hudhelpers.js (826), hudeditor.js (588), notifications.js (812), replaystudio.js (1615), profiles.js (1386), practice.js (707), director.js (1598), macroeditor.js (511), plugins.js (940), lab.js (245), discovery.js (613), smalltools.js (1219), perf.js (1848), themeworkshop.js (1254), hotkeysCommand.js (2056)
- **PWA**: Progressive Web App with fullscreen game mode, manifest.json ("Legend Mod - Expanding Land"), landscape orientation, theme_color #00243e; no service worker on this site (the old one is unregistered by play.html; the Expanding Land app at expanding.land has its own)
- **Extension**: Chrome extension "Legend Express" (manifest v3, version 1.8.5, author Jimboy3100). Permissions: storage, declarativeNetRequest. Host permissions: agar.io, jimboy3100.github.io, legendmod.ml, sigmally.com, senpa.io, mi.com. Content scripts run on agar.io at document_start. Background: service worker. Does NOT collect, store or transmit personal data externally.
- **Userscript**: Legend Express userscript for Tampermonkey / Greasemonkey (https://www.legendmod.ml/LMexpress/LMexpress.user.js), version 1.9.
- **LMEvents API**: Hook system for user scripts (developers/LMEvents.md). Frozen plain data for listeners, failing listeners logged but don't stop the game.

## Expanding Land (Game)

Expanding Land (entity: https://expanding.land/#game) is a free multiplayer browser cell game. It is NOT Agar.io — it is an independent game built from scratch.

### Core Mechanics
- **Dynamic circular arena**: The server controls a circular map boundary that expands and contracts based on player count. Map scale ranges from 0.25× to 8×. Players must adapt to changing play space.
- **Cell growth**: Collect food pellets (+1 mass each) and consume smaller cells to grow larger.
- **Splitting**: Press Space to divide your cell into two halves (up to 16 fragments). Need approximately 2.6× target mass to split-kill.
- **Mass ejection**: Press W to eject a small mass pellet toward the cursor (~15-16 mass cost per press).
- **Mass decay**: Cells lose approximately 0.8% of mass every 4 seconds. Bigger cells decay faster.
- **Viruses**: Spiky green circles. Big cells pop into ~16 pieces when hitting a virus. Feed 7 W-presses into a virus to shoot it at another player (~100-110 mass cost).
- **Merge timer**: After splitting, cells rejoin after a timer (bigger cells take longer to merge).
- **Ghost cells**: Transparent cells showing where you died (EL-exclusive feature).
- **Spectator mode**: 200+ spectator slots with free-roam camera. Players can spectate without playing.

### Game Modes
- **Free-for-all (FFA)**: Competitive individual play. Every player for themselves.
- **Teams**: Team-based play on supported arenas with assigned team colours.

### Players and Bots
Human and server-controlled bot populations vary by arena. In-game counters distinguish between human and bot counts. Server-controlled bots are distinct from external automation (automated third-party clients).

### Anti-Teaming System
Exponential multiplier decay system (ported from Delta Server): decay = base × pow(1.086, multiplier). Recovery via -0.005/cycle compensation. Penalty values: W press +0.1, split +0.5, virus pop +0.5, danger zone +0.01 per cycle. Decay impact: multiplier 5 → 1.51× decay, multiplier 10 → 2.28× decay. Teams mode override: at_eject_loss=0.0. Configured per server via at_extra_decay_base, at_compensation, at_split_loss, at_eject_loss, at_virus_pop_loss, at_danger_loss parameters.

### Danger Zone
During arena contraction, the outer ring becomes a Danger Zone. Being in it adds +0.01 to the anti-teaming multiplier per cycle, discouraging camping at the edges.

### Anti-Cheat
Coordinate scrambling: each connected player receives unique offsets (scramble_x, scramble_y, scramble_id) using LCG PRNG seeded per connection, preventing external tools from sharing exact positions. Additional security: TLS ban table, WebSocket handshake rate limiting, constant-time password comparison, MurmurHash3 IP hashing, IPv6 /64 prefix grouping.

### Server Technology
- Written in pure C for performance (~5ms tick)
- Supports up to 3,840 simultaneous players per arena; how many people and server-controlled bots are online varies
- Encrypted WebSocket connections (WSS/TLS)
- OpenMP parallelised for multi-core scaling
- Live /status endpoint showing player count, spectators, uptime and map scale
- Server at ffa.legendmod.ml:8080

### Session Stats
Tracked per life: time alive, highest mass, food eaten, players eaten.

### Compatible Mods
- Legend Mod (legendmod.ml) — skins, themes, controls, multibox, replays
- Delta Mod (deltio.pages.dev)
- Agar2 (agar2.com)

### Multiboxing Limit
Up to 4 simultaneous accounts per player in Expanding Land.

### Login
Discord OAuth login supported. Google Sign-In for account features. Guest play requires no login.

### Mobile and Android
PWA support with fullscreen landscape play. Android APK available for direct install. Mobile touch controls for split, feed and movement.

Official website: https://expanding.land/
Help and documentation: https://help.expanding.land/

Glossary: https://help.expanding.land/glossary.html

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is Legend Mod?**
Legend Mod is a browser client and Chrome extension that adds custom skins, themes, configurable controls, multiboxing, replays, and many other features to Agar.io-style cell games. It is not a game itself.

**Is Legend Mod the same as Agar.io?**
No. Legend Mod is a separate extension/client project. Agar.io is a game by Miniclip. Expanding Land is a separate independent game. These are three distinct entities.

**Is Expanding Land the official Agar.io service?**
No. Expanding Land is an independent multiplayer cell game built from scratch in C. It is not affiliated with Agar.io or Miniclip.

**Does the Expanding Land map change?**
Yes. The server controls expansion and contraction of the circular arena. The map scale ranges from 0.25× to 8× based on player activity.

**Are all opponents in Expanding Land human?**
Not necessarily. Human and server-controlled bot counts vary by arena. In-game counters distinguish the populations.

**What is the maximum player count?**
Expanding Land supports up to 3,840 simultaneous players per arena. Actual counts depend on server configuration and should not be confused with measured concurrent human attendance.

**How do I install Legend Mod?**
Install the "Legend Express" Chrome extension from the Chrome Web Store, or visit the play page at legendmod.ml/play.html to use the web client directly.

**What languages does Legend Mod support?**
16 languages: Arabic, Bulgarian, German, Greek, English, Spanish, French, Indonesian (beta), Italian (beta), Japanese (beta), Dutch, Polish, Portuguese (beta), Russian, Turkish, and Traditional Chinese.

**Is Legend Mod free?**
Yes. Legend Mod and Expanding Land are free to use with no subscription required.

**Does Legend Mod collect personal data?**
The Chrome extension does NOT collect, store or transmit personal data externally. See the privacy policy at legendmod.ml/privacy.html.

**What is a scan trick?**
A movement technique where cursor position snaps to fixed directional increments (8-32 directions). This allows precise cell positioning for split tricks and other advanced gameplay.

**What is line split?**
A rapid multi-split technique (x8 or x16) in a straight line toward the cursor. Configurable timing (delay between splits) and lock duration.

**What is the companion second screen?**
A feature that broadcasts live game state (minimap, mass, cell positions, chat) to a second browser window or device via BroadcastChannel. Useful for multi-monitor setups or streaming.

**What is the death recap?**
A Game Over card feature showing the last 20 seconds of your life as 3-6 summarised steps with a mass sparkline, plus the killer's name and mass.

**What is the Practice Arena?**
An offline mode where you practice against bots without connecting to a server. Uses MultiOgar protocol. Tracks personal bests and replays ghost of your best run.

**What is the Theme Workshop?**
A tool to create, save, rename, copy and delete custom themes. Supports up to 30 themes with 5 versions each, live preview with auto-revert, side-by-side comparison, and a gallery of shipped themes.

**What are Settings Profiles?**
Named sets of all gameplay and visual settings that can be switched instantly. Supports up to 30 profiles, auto-switching per server/mode/input device, and 5 automatic backups.

**What is the Spectator Director?**
An automatic camera system that follows the most interesting action while spectating. Includes watchlist, map bookmarks (up to 20), cinematic camera, broadcast HUD, and leaderboard history.

**What are User Scripts / Plugins?**
Legend Mod supports 5 user script slots for custom JavaScript extensions. Plugins use a standard header format and can register settings via the LMPlugins API. A catalogue of example plugins is available.

**How does mass decay work in Expanding Land?**
Cells lose approximately 0.8% of mass every 4 seconds. Bigger cells decay proportionally faster, making extreme size difficult to maintain. The anti-teaming system can accelerate decay further via its exponential multiplier.

**How does the merge timer work?**
After splitting, cells cannot recombine immediately. The timer depends on each cell's mass — bigger cells take longer to merge. Legend Mod shows a countdown overlay and progress rings on your cells, plus an optional sound alert when cells are ready to merge.

**What game modes does Expanding Land have?**
Free-for-all (FFA) for competitive solo play, Teams for team-based play with assigned colours, and Experimental/Battle Royale modes on select arenas. Mode 5001 is a private server mode.

**What server regions are available?**
US-Atlanta and EU-London are the primary regions. Private servers (mode 5001) can also be hosted. The monitor page at legendmod.ml/monitor/ shows all active servers and their regions in real time.

**What is the Player Monitor?**
A live dashboard at legendmod.ml/monitor/ showing all online players, their servers, regions, game modes, levels, countries, and last seen times. It includes a History page for tracking player activity over time.

**How do I log in to Expanding Land?**
Discord OAuth and Google Sign-In are supported for account features (level, stats, name history). Guest play requires no login — you can play immediately with any nickname.

**Can I play on mobile?**
Yes. Expanding Land supports PWA with fullscreen landscape play and screen wake lock. An Android APK is also available. Legend Mod's mobile touch controls provide on-screen buttons for split, feed, and movement.

**What is coordinate scrambling?**
An anti-cheat system where each connected player receives unique random coordinate offsets from the server (scramble_x, scramble_y, scramble_id). This prevents external tools or bots from sharing exact player positions between accounts.

**How does the anti-teaming system work?**
It uses an exponential decay multiplier (Delta Server-style): decay = base × pow(1.086, multiplier). Actions like W-pressing (+0.1), splitting near allies (+0.5), virus popping (+0.5), and sitting in the Danger Zone (+0.01/cycle) increase the multiplier. Recovery is -0.005 per cycle. In Teams mode, eject loss is set to 0.

**How do viruses work?**
Viruses are spiky green circles. Big cells pop into ~16 pieces when touching one. Small and medium cells pass through safely. Feed 7 W-presses into a virus to shoot it toward another player (~100-110 mass cost). This is a key offensive tactic called a virus shot.

**What is the Replay Studio?**
A full playback tool for game replays with timeline, automatic bookmarks, variable speed (0.25x-4x), pause, packet-by-packet stepping, forward/backward seeking, and timeline scrubbing. Replays are saved as .lm files and stored in IndexedDB.

**What is the HUD Editor?**
A tool to drag and resize 15 HUD components (leaderboard, minimap, stats, chat, etc.) into named layouts. Up to 20 layouts with grid snapping (8/16/32px), lock/unlock, and edge-relative positioning for responsiveness.

**What is the Analytics Dashboard?**
A statistics window with heatmaps, play pattern analysis (coach), up to 8 custom objectives, 500 game summaries, and split analysis. It tracks position history (3,600 samples per game, 50 games) and provides tips based on your play patterns.

**What is the Radial Menu?**
A hold-point-release radial command menu with up to 8 slots. Assign any hotkey command to a slot for quick access without memorising keys. Hold the radial menu key, point to a slot, and release to activate.

**How do presets work?**
Legend Mod offers one-click presets: Competitive (enables rings, mass, split range), Battery Saver (caps FPS, disables effects), Streamer (hides personal info), Reduced Motion (no animations), and Clean HUD (minimal interface). Theme presets include 8 colour schemes.

**What is ghost cells?**
An Expanding Land-exclusive feature. When you die, a transparent cell appears at your death location, visible on the minimap. Ghost cells help you track where deaths occurred and avoid dangerous areas.

**How do sound controls work?**
Legend Mod has a 6-channel sound mixer: Master, Chat, Commands, Gameplay, Video, and Notifications. Each channel has independent volume (0-100%). Additional toggles for virus sounds, x16 split sounds, merge sounds, and audio ducking (chat lowers video skin volume).

## Glossary of Key Terms

- **Cell**: The circular blob each player controls, also called blob/player/ball
- **Mass**: Cell size/weight, displayed as a number; decays ~0.8% every 4 seconds
- **Food/Pellets**: Small coloured dots worth +1 mass each
- **Split**: Dividing your cell into two halves (Space key), up to 16 fragments
- **Eject mass (W)**: Firing a small pellet toward cursor, costs ~15-16 mass
- **Virus**: Spiky green circle that pops big cells into ~16 pieces; shoot with 7 W-presses
- **Merge/Recombine**: Split cells rejoin after a timer (bigger = longer)
- **Decay**: Automatic mass loss (~0.8% every 4 seconds)
- **Ghost cell**: Transparent cell showing death location (Expanding Land feature)
- **Dynamic map**: Arena that auto-resizes (0.25× to 8×) based on player count
- **Danger zone**: Outer ring during map contraction; anti-teaming penalty area
- **Tricksplit**: Rapid double/triple split for extended range
- **Popsplit**: Intentional virus pop combined with split
- **Cannon/Self-feed**: Rapid W between own split cells for mass transfer
- **Line split**: Straight-line rapid multi-split for maximum distance
- **Scan trick**: Cursor snapping to fixed directional increments
- **Teaming**: Two or more players cooperating; EL has anti-teaming system
- **Multiboxing**: Controlling multiple game connections simultaneously (up to 4 in EL)
- **Spectator**: 200+ slots with free-roam camera in Expanding Land
- **Coordinate scrambling**: Anti-cheat system giving different position offsets per player
- **Theme Workshop**: Tool to create, save and manage up to 30 custom themes
- **Settings Profile**: Named snapshot of all settings, switchable instantly
- **Practice Arena**: Offline mode for practising against bots
- **Replay Studio**: Full playback tool for recorded game replays
- **LMEvents**: Hook API for user scripts to listen to game events
- **HUD Editor**: Tool for dragging and resizing HUD elements into named layouts
